_note: v2.4 plan 06 T16a objective line, LIVE (real model, profile selected, no debugResponse; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <id>, twice). Every non-dry GENERATE_AFTER_DATA request is recorded with the checkpoint active when it was built. A request on cp-bare (objective, no own Author's Note: the predicate a generated checkpoint takes) must carry 'Objective: Find the brass key'; a request on cp-noted (authors its own note) must carry no 'Objective:' line. The over-steer probe (family objective) measures reply N+1 on cp-bare against the cp-noted control reply to the same player line; it gates on restating the line or narrating the objective as achieved. Extraction cadence is pinned high so a real read cannot move the story mid-check; the pinned value is restored by the runner (S11). Control arm with objective_block off: live-v24-06-objective-off.json.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 50 }); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (globalThis.__soObjectiveProbe?.off) globalThis.__soObjectiveProbe.off(); const probe = globalThis.__soObjectiveProbe = { requests: [] }; const listener = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; probe.requests.push({ active: rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null, body: JSON.stringify(data ?? null) }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); probe.off = () => ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); return { installed: true };

const value = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''; if (value.includes('Objective:')) throw new Error('cp-noted authors its own note, yet the guidance block carries the objective line: ' + JSON.stringify(value)); return { block: value.slice(0, 160) };

send_generate.text: I stand still in the dark hallway and listen for footsteps.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const replies = ctx.chat.filter((m) => !m.is_user && !m.is_system); globalThis.__soObjectiveControl = String(replies.at(-1)?.mes ?? ''); if (!globalThis.__soObjectiveControl.trim()) throw new Error('the control arm got no reply'); return { control: globalThis.__soObjectiveControl.slice(0, 160) };

const value = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_guidance?.value ?? ''; if (!value.includes('Objective: Find the brass key')) throw new Error('cp-bare has no note of its own, yet the guidance block carries no objective line: ' + JSON.stringify(value)); return { block: value.slice(0, 200) };

send_generate.text: I stand still in the dark hallway and listen for footsteps.

steps.eval: const probe = globalThis.__soObjectiveProbe; probe.off(); const bare = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.active === 'cp-bare'); const noted = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.active === 'cp-noted'); if (!bare.length) throw new Error('no request was built on cp-bare: ' + JSON.stringify(probe.requests.map((r) => r.active))); if (!noted.length) throw new Error('no request was built on cp-noted (the control arm)'); const missing = bare.filter((r) => !r.body.includes('Objective: Find the brass key')); if (missing.length) throw new Error('a request on cp-bare does not carry the objective line'); const leaked = noted.filter((r) => r.body.includes('Objective:')); if (leaked.length) throw new Error('a request on cp-noted carries an objective line although it authors its own note'); return { bare: bare.length, noted: noted.length };
